hook: Water board gives sewage-treated water *free*; you pay only transport
hook_b: Water board gives sewage-treated water *free*; you pay only transport
tldr: HMWSSB's Dial-a-Green Tanker scheme supplies treated water from sewage treatment plants at no cost for non-drinking uses; users pay only transport.

beats.what: Builders, commercial buildings and apartment associations can register their own tankers or book through the water board.
beats.why: To cut use of drinking water and pressure on groundwater for construction and gardening.
beats.care: Apartments and sites can book on helpline 155313; the water is for curing, gardening and landscaping, not drinking.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: One Cyberabad developer already draws 90,000-1.2 lakh litres a day from the Kokapet STP, per TOI.

cards.q: Would your apartment use treated water for gardens?

qs: Should large gated communities be required to use treated water?

facts.t: Each green tanker carries *30,000-40,000 litres*, with 3-4 trips a day for one developer.

learn.t: STP = sewage treatment plant, which cleans waste water for reuse

watch: How many builders and apartments sign up as summer approaches.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Opt for treated water, water board urges builders in Hyderabad

fact: Hyderabad water board now gives treated sewage water *free* for construction and gardens
twist: The board's target: save at least *20%* of the city's drinking water through such switches.
